title: 🔎 What to watch out for this Friday at the Club World Cup
content:
The second round of group stage matches continues on Friday in the FIFA Club World Cup and from OneFootball we bring you the most interesting things from the day.

Register on DAZN to watch ALL FIFA Club World Cup matches for FREE.

📸 PATRICIA DE MELO MOREIRA - AFP or licensors

Will Bayern unleash its full offensive fury against Boca Juniors again? The challenge grows for the German champion in a completely different scenario from its debut against Auckland City.

Today is also an important day in group D with Flamengo and Chelsea in the spotlight seeking leadership. LAFC and Espérance play to avoid packing their bags too early.

📸 Dylan Buell - 2025 Getty Images

His hat-trick in the first round was a delight for those who have been waiting for his return to the scene after the injury. He is one of the greatest young talents in the world and today he will face, against Boca, a match that can mark trajectories.

The one who appears in the middle of the water while the hours pass for the duel against Bayern is Sebastián Battaglia, a legend of Boca Juniors, who takes the pertinent ovation and chant from his own fans.
